votes.motion: Approve the variance for 11 Peninsula Drive (reduce groundwater offset from 5 feet to 4 feet).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by pa ssios and second by fortin, the variance was approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 1190 Northfield Road (groundwater offset 4 feet to 2 feet; wetlands offset 100 feet to 69 feet).
votes.quote: after much discussion and on motion by mayhew and second by jewell, the variances were approved.

votes.motion: Grant the variance for 157 Townsend Harbor Road (groundwater offset four feet to 3 feet; inlet and outlet tees under 12 inches).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by fortin and second by mayhew the variance was granted.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 71 Highland Street (groundwater offset reduction; inlet and outlet tees under 12 inches).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion b y passios and second by mayhew, the variances were approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 113 Sandy Cove Road (groundwater offset 4 feet to 3 feet; inlet and outlet tees under 12 inches).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by fortin and second by mayhew, the variances were approved.

votes.motion: Allow the Lanni Orchard APR to proceed, with the owners proceeding at their own risk if DEP later finds the land division falls under subdivision rules.
votes.quote: after much discussion and on motion by passios and second by mayhew, th e board voted to allow the apr to proceed
